narrative.narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues rose to 716.8 million dollars, 0.2637 percent of the 271.8 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 487.6 million dollars and 0.1797 percent in the prior reading. Binance took in 552.8 million dollars, OKX took in 208.1 million dollars, and Gate took in 183.6 million dollars, while Bitstamp posted a 101.5 million dollar outflow and Crypto.com posted a 74.4 million dollar outflow. The pipe measures the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the larger positive total means more money arrived than in the prior reading, with Binance, OKX, and Gate the largest arrivals.
